"""Source-pinned, unselected bicycle/officer alley capture requests."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CASE = HERE.parent.parent
ROOT = CASE.parents[1]
ASSIGNMENT_SHA = "58c5a14d7c38851c0672c4e8cb5cf02eede790eec53a8fd6d5ffd541893c8419"
RATE = 20
FRAMES = 480
DEVICE_X = 50.0
STOP_X = 44.0
POLICIES = {
    "primary": {"speed": 4.0, "view": "standard", "officer_x": 39.0, "officer_y": -8.0},
    "fallback1": {"speed": 2.5, "view": "standard", "officer_x": 39.0, "officer_y": -8.0},
    "fallback2": {"speed": 4.0, "view": "elevated", "officer_x": 39.0, "officer_y": -8.0},
    "fallback3": {"speed": 4.0, "view": "standard", "officer_x": 35.0, "officer_y": -10.0},
}
CASES = {"probe_a": "no_contrary_direction", "probe_b": "proceed_request"}


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def write_json(path, obj):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(obj, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")


def road():
    return '''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<OpenDRIVE><header revMajor="1" revMinor="4" name="C10365 alley officer request" version="1.00" date="2026-11-08" north="4" south="-4" east="120" west="0" vendor="worker"/>
<road name="alley with authored stop cue" length="120" id="365" junction="-1">
<type s="0" type="town"><speed max="20" unit="mph"/></type>
<planView><geometry s="0" x="0" y="0" hdg="0" length="120"><line/></geometry></planView>
<lanes><laneSection s="0"><center><lane id="0" type="none" level="false"><roadMark sOffset="0" type="solid" color="yellow" width="0.15"/></lane></center><right><lane id="-1" type="driving" level="false"><width sOffset="0" a="3.5" b="0" c="0" d="0"/><roadMark sOffset="0" type="solid" color="white" width="0.12"/></lane></right></laneSection></lanes>
<objects/><signals><signal id="3651" name="C10365_authored_stop_cue" s="50" t="-4.2" zOffset="0" hOffset="0" pitch="0" roll="0" dynamic="no" orientation="+" country="US" type="206" subtype="0" value="0" height="0.75" width="0.75"/></signals>
</road></OpenDRIVE>
'''


def requested_rows(suffix, candidate):
    speed = POLICIES[candidate]["speed"]
    crossing = suffix == "probe_b"
    reach = (STOP_X - 5.0) / speed
    rows = []
    for frame in range(FRAMES):
        t = (frame + 1) / RATE
        if t < reach:
            x, target = 5.0 + speed * t, speed
        elif crossing:
            x, target = STOP_X + speed * (t - reach), speed
        else:
            x, target = STOP_X, 0.0
        rows.append({
            "frame": frame, "time_s": t, "requested_rider_x_m": round(x, 6),
            "requested_rider_y_m": -1.75, "requested_speed_mps": target,
            "requested_officer_cue": CASES[suffix],
            "officer_direction_observed": None, "officer_authority_verified": False,
            "official_device_verified": False, "legal_verdict": None,
        })
    return rows


def build():
    assignment = ROOT / "inputs" / CASE.name / "assignment.json"
    plan_path = CASE / "case-plan.json"
    a, plan = json.loads(assignment.read_text()), json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
    law = a["law_record"]["text"]
    if (sha(assignment) != ASSIGNMENT_SHA or plan["statutory_text"] != law or
            a["cell"]["layout"] != "alley" or a["cell"]["maneuver"] != "travel" or
            a["cell"]["control"] != "police_officer" or
            a["actor"] != "cycle_or_scooter_operator" or
            "unless otherwise directed by a Police Officer" not in law):
        raise ValueError("Frozen source or statutory branch changed")
    road_path = HERE / "alley-stop.xodr"
    road_path.write_text(road())
    entries = []
    for suffix in CASES:
        for candidate, policy in POLICIES.items():
            bundle = HERE / "drafts" / suffix / candidate
            bundle.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            tracks = bundle / "requested-tracks.jsonl"
            tracks.write_text("".join(json.dumps(r, sort_keys=True) + "\n"
                                      for r in requested_rows(suffix, candidate)))
            (bundle / "assignment-source.json").write_bytes(assignment.read_bytes())
            (bundle / "case-plan.json").write_bytes(plan_path.read_bytes())
            (bundle / "alley-stop.xodr").write_text(road())
            cfg = {
                "format": "c10365-officer-native-request-v1",
                "assignment_id": CASE.name, "case_id": CASE.name + "__" + suffix,
                "candidate_id": candidate, "assignment_sha256": sha(assignment),
                "case_plan_sha256": sha(plan_path), "road_sha256": sha(road_path),
                "tracks_sha256": sha(tracks), "source_text": law,
                "rate_hz": RATE, "frames": FRAMES, "device_id": "3651",
                "device_station_x_m": DEVICE_X, "rider_blueprint": "vehicle.bh.crossbike",
                "officer_blueprint_filter": "walker.pedestrian.*",
                "officer_position_xy_m": [policy["officer_x"], policy["officer_y"]],
                "officer_role_requested": "Police Officer", "officer_role_verified": False,
                "officer_cue_requested": CASES[suffix], "officer_direction_observed": None,
                "camera_policy": policy["view"], "requested_speed_mps": policy["speed"],
                "official_device_verified": False, "original_native_observed": False,
                "status": "unselected_native_request",
            }
            write_json(bundle / "config.json", cfg)
            entries.append({"case_id": cfg["case_id"], "candidate_id": candidate,
                            "config_sha256": sha(bundle / "config.json"),
                            "tracks_sha256": sha(tracks)})
    manifest = {
        "format": "c10365-officer-native-construction-v1",
        "assignment_id": CASE.name, "assignment_sha256": sha(assignment),
        "case_plan_sha256": sha(plan_path), "road_sha256": sha(road_path),
        "entries": entries, "original_native_observed": False, "delivery_ready": False,
    }
    write_json(HERE / "manifest.json", manifest)
    return manifest


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(json.dumps({"requests": len(build()["entries"])}))

"""Offline check for exact copied C10365 candidate sources."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

from build import ASSIGNMENT_SHA, CASES, DEVICE_X, FRAMES, POLICIES, RATE, requested_rows, road


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def check(bundle):
    bundle = Path(bundle)
    cfg = json.loads((bundle / "config.json").read_text())
    a = json.loads((bundle / "assignment-source.json").read_text())
    p = json.loads((bundle / "case-plan.json").read_text())
    suffix = cfg["case_id"].split("__")[-1]
    candidate = cfg["candidate_id"]
    law = a["law_record"]["text"]
    if (suffix not in CASES or candidate not in POLICIES or
            sha(bundle / "assignment-source.json") != ASSIGNMENT_SHA or
            cfg["assignment_id"] != a["assignment_id"] or
            cfg["case_id"] != a["assignment_id"] + "__" + suffix or
            cfg["source_text"] != law or p["statutory_text"] != law or
            a["cell"]["layout"] != "alley" or a["cell"]["maneuver"] != "travel" or
            a["cell"]["control"] != "police_officer" or
            a["actor"] != "cycle_or_scooter_operator" or
            "unless otherwise directed by a Police Officer" not in law):
        raise ValueError("Exact law, actor, branch or cell changed")
    for key, name in (("assignment_sha256", "assignment-source.json"),
                      ("case_plan_sha256", "case-plan.json"),
                      ("road_sha256", "alley-stop.xodr"),
                      ("tracks_sha256", "requested-tracks.jsonl")):
        if cfg[key] != sha(bundle / name):
            raise ValueError("Copied source hash " + name)
    if (bundle / "alley-stop.xodr").read_text() != road():
        raise ValueError("Authored topology changed")
    root = ET.parse(bundle / "alley-stop.xodr").getroot()
    signal = root.find("./road/signals/signal")
    if (root.find("./road").get("id") != "365" or
            signal is None or signal.get("id") != "3651" or
            signal.get("type") != "206" or signal.get("s") != "50" or
            [lane.get("id") for lane in root.findall("./road/lanes/laneSection/right/lane")] != ["-1"]):
        raise ValueError("Road, lane or cue source")
    policy = POLICIES[candidate]
    if (cfg["format"] != "c10365-officer-native-request-v1" or
            cfg["rate_hz"] != RATE or cfg["frames"] != FRAMES or
            cfg["device_id"] != "3651" or cfg["device_station_x_m"] != DEVICE_X or
            cfg["rider_blueprint"] != "vehicle.bh.crossbike" or
            cfg["officer_blueprint_filter"] != "walker.pedestrian.*" or
            cfg["officer_position_xy_m"] != [policy["officer_x"], policy["officer_y"]] or
            cfg["officer_cue_requested"] != CASES[suffix] or
            cfg["camera_policy"] != policy["view"] or
            cfg["requested_speed_mps"] != policy["speed"] or
            cfg["officer_role_verified"] is not False or
            cfg["officer_direction_observed"] is not None or
            cfg["official_device_verified"] is not False or
            cfg["original_native_observed"] is not False or
            cfg["status"] != "unselected_native_request"):
        raise ValueError("Candidate policy or unverified status")
    rows = [json.loads(x) for x in (bundle / "requested-tracks.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    if rows != requested_rows(suffix, candidate):
        raise ValueError("Source-bound requested frames")
    stop = sum(row["requested_speed_mps"] == 0 for row in rows)
    crossing = any(row["requested_rider_x_m"] > DEVICE_X for row in rows)
    if suffix == "probe_a" and (stop == 0 or crossing):
        raise ValueError("Ordinary request trajectory")
    if suffix == "probe_b" and (stop or not crossing):
        raise ValueError("Officer exception request trajectory")
    return {"case_id": cfg["case_id"], "candidate_id": candidate,
            "requested_stop_frames": stop, "requested_crossing": crossing,
            "officer_direction_observed": None, "legal_verdict": None,
            "delivery_ready": False}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--bundle", type=Path, required=True)
    print(json.dumps(check(parser.parse_args().bundle)))

"""Attempt original CARLA bicycle, officer actor, stop cue and joined FFV1 capture.

An actor role name or a requested cue does not establish police authority,
an observed gesture, official sign placement or a legal conclusion.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import queue
import subprocess
import traceback

from build import FRAMES
from check import check


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def write_new(path, value):
    with Path(path).open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")


def body(actor):
    transform = actor.get_transform()
    velocity = actor.get_velocity()
    points = actor.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(transform)
    return {"actor_id": actor.id, "blueprint": actor.type_id,
            "center_native_xyz_m": [transform.location.x, transform.location.y,
                                    transform.location.z],
            "yaw_deg": transform.rotation.yaw,
            "velocity_native_xyz_mps": [velocity.x, velocity.y, velocity.z],
            "speed_mps": math.sqrt(velocity.x ** 2 + velocity.y ** 2 + velocity.z ** 2),
            "body_native_xyz_m": [[p.x, p.y, p.z] for p in points]}


def capture(bundle, output, host, port):
    import carla
    import numpy as np
    from pipeline_capture import PipelineCapture
    from scenario_pipeline.worker_exchange.world_restore import snapshot, restore

    bundle, output = Path(bundle).resolve(), Path(output).resolve()
    checked = check(bundle)
    cfg = json.loads((bundle / "config.json").read_text())
    requests = [json.loads(r) for r in (bundle / "requested-tracks.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    client = carla.Client(host, int(port))
    client.set_timeout(180)
    prior = client.get_world()
    saved = snapshot(client)
    if prior.get_settings().synchronous_mode or any(
            a.type_id.startswith(("vehicle.", "walker.", "sensor."))
            for a in prior.get_actors()):
        raise RuntimeError("Exclusive idle asynchronous CARLA world required")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    owned, encoders, logs, queues = [], {}, {}, {}
    changed, frames, error, restored, pipeline = False, 0, None, None, None
    landmark_readback = None
    try:
        world = client.generate_opendrive_world(
            (bundle / "alley-stop.xodr").read_text(),
            carla.OpendriveGenerationParameters(
                vertex_distance=.25, max_road_length=50, wall_height=0,
                additional_width=0, smooth_junctions=False,
                enable_mesh_visibility=True, enable_pedestrian_navigation=False))
        changed = True
        settings = world.get_settings()
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = .05
        settings.substepping = True
        settings.max_substep_delta_time = .01
        settings.max_substeps = 10
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        world.set_weather(carla.WeatherParameters.ClearNoon)
        mapping = world.get_map()
        lane_rows = {}
        for x in (20, 45, 55):
            wp = mapping.get_waypoint(carla.Location(x=x, y=-1.75, z=1),
                                      project_to_road=False, lane_type=carla.LaneType.Any)
            lane_rows[str(x)] = None if wp is None else {
                "road_id": wp.road_id, "lane_id": wp.lane_id,
                "lane_type": "driving" if wp.lane_type == carla.LaneType.Driving else "other"}
            if wp is None or wp.road_id != 365 or wp.lane_id != -1 or \
                    wp.lane_type != carla.LaneType.Driving:
                raise RuntimeError("Generated alley lane differs")
        matches = [
            {"id": str(item.id), "road_id": int(item.road_id),
             "s_m": float(item.s), "type": str(item.type)}
            for item in mapping.get_all_landmarks()
            if str(item.id) == "3651" and int(item.road_id) == 365
            and abs(float(item.s) - 50) < .5 and str(item.type) == "206"]
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise RuntimeError("Generated stop landmark absent or ambiguous")
        landmark_readback = matches[0]
        library = world.get_blueprint_library()
        rider_bp = library.find("vehicle.bh.crossbike")
        rider_bp.set_attribute("role_name", "c10365_rider")
        rider = world.try_spawn_actor(
            rider_bp, carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=5, y=-1.75, z=1.5)))
        if rider is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Bicycle spawn failed")
        owned.append(rider)
        walkers = sorted(library.filter("walker.pedestrian.*"), key=lambda bp: bp.id)
        if not walkers:
            raise RuntimeError("No Native walker blueprint for officer staging")
        officer_bp = walkers[0]
        if officer_bp.has_attribute("role_name"):
            officer_bp.set_attribute("role_name", "c10365_officer_request")
        officer = world.try_spawn_actor(
            officer_bp, carla.Transform(
                carla.Location(x=cfg["officer_position_xy_m"][0],
                               y=cfg["officer_position_xy_m"][1], z=1.0),
                carla.Rotation(yaw=90)))
        if officer is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Officer-stage walker spawn failed")
        owned.append(officer)
        elevated = cfg["camera_policy"] == "elevated"
        specs = (("overview", 1280, 720, 90 if elevated else 80,
                  (48, -16, 45 if elevated else 25), -70 if elevated else -55),
                 ("rider_forward", 1280, 720, 90, (1, 0, 1.5), 0),
                 ("officer_side", 1280, 720, 75, (42, -12, 4), -15))
        for name, width, height, fov, xyz, pitch in specs:
            bp = library.find("sensor.camera.rgb")
            for key, value in (("image_size_x", width), ("image_size_y", height),
                               ("fov", fov), ("sensor_tick", 0)):
                bp.set_attribute(key, str(value))
            camera = world.spawn_actor(
                bp, carla.Transform(carla.Location(*xyz), carla.Rotation(pitch=pitch)),
                attach_to=rider if name == "rider_forward" else None)
            owned.append(camera)
            queues[name] = queue.Queue()
            camera.listen(queues[name].put)
            logs[name] = (output / (name + ".encoder.log")).open("x")
            encoders[name] = subprocess.Popen(
                ["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-n",
                 "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "rgb24", "-s", f"{width}x{height}",
                 "-r", "20", "-i", "pipe:0", "-an", "-c:v", "ffv1",
                 str(output / (name + ".mkv"))],
                stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=logs[name])
        write_new(output / "native-map-readback.json", {
            "source_kind": "original_native",
            "road_sha256": sha(bundle / "alley-stop.xodr"),
            "native_map_sha256": hashlib.sha256(mapping.to_opendrive().encode()).hexdigest(),
            "lane_readback": lane_rows, "stop_landmark_readback": landmark_readback,
            "rider_actor_id": rider.id, "officer_actor_id": officer.id,
            "officer_blueprint": officer.type_id, "officer_role_verified": False,
            "officer_direction_observed": None, "official_device_verified": False,
            "legal_verdict": None})
        for _ in range(20):
            world.tick()
        pipeline = PipelineCapture(client, rider, output, cfg["case_id"], visibility=False)
        start = world.get_snapshot().timestamp.elapsed_seconds
        with (output / "native-raw-actors.jsonl").open("x") as actors, \
             (output / "video_frames.jsonl").open("x") as videos:
            for i, requested in enumerate(requests):
                # A distinct Native hand pose is attempted for the contrary-cue
                # witness. Its visible meaning remains a human review question.
                bones = carla.WalkerBoneControl()
                bones.bone_transforms = [
                    ("crl_hand__R", carla.Transform(rotation=carla.Rotation(
                        roll=90 if cfg["officer_cue_requested"] == "proceed_request" else 0)))]
                officer.apply_control(bones)
                rider.set_target_velocity(
                    carla.Vector3D(x=requested["requested_speed_mps"], y=0, z=0))
                frame = world.tick()
                time_s = world.get_snapshot().timestamp.elapsed_seconds - start
                wp = mapping.get_waypoint(rider.get_transform().location,
                                          project_to_road=False, lane_type=carla.LaneType.Any)
                row = {
                    "frame": i, "native_frame": frame, "time_s": time_s,
                    "source_kind": "original_native", "rider": body(rider),
                    "officer_actor": body(officer),
                    "officer_cue_requested": cfg["officer_cue_requested"],
                    "officer_hand_roll_requested_deg": 90 if
                        cfg["officer_cue_requested"] == "proceed_request" else 0,
                    "officer_role_verified": False, "officer_direction_observed": None,
                    "requested_rider_x_m": requested["requested_rider_x_m"],
                    "requested_speed_mps": requested["requested_speed_mps"],
                    "observed_road_id": None if wp is None else wp.road_id,
                    "observed_lane_id": None if wp is None else wp.lane_id,
                    "official_device_verified": False, "legal_verdict": None}
                actors.write(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                pipeline.capture(frame, time_s, extra={"c10365_officer": row})
                for name, width, height, _, _, _ in specs:
                    image = queues[name].get(timeout=30)
                    while image.frame < frame:
                        image = queues[name].get(timeout=30)
                    if image.frame != frame:
                        raise RuntimeError("Native/video frame join failed")
                    rgb = np.frombuffer(image.raw_data, dtype=np.uint8).reshape(
                        height, width, 4)[:, :, :3][:, :, ::-1]
                    encoders[name].stdin.write(rgb.tobytes())
                videos.write(json.dumps({"video_frame": i, "native_frame": frame,
                                         "time_s": time_s}) + "\n")
                frames += 1
    except BaseException as exc:
        error = {"type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc),
                 "traceback": traceback.format_exc()}
    finally:
        if pipeline is not None:
            try:
                pipeline.close(confirmed=error is None)
            except BaseException as exc:
                error = error or {"capture_close_error": str(exc)}
        for name, encoder in encoders.items():
            try:
                encoder.stdin.close()
                if encoder.wait(timeout=180) != 0:
                    raise RuntimeError("FFV1 encoder failed")
            except BaseException as exc:
                error = error or {"encoder_error": str(exc)}
            logs[name].close()
        for actor in reversed(owned):
            try:
                if actor.type_id.startswith("sensor.") and actor.is_listening:
                    actor.stop()
                actor.destroy()
            except BaseException as exc:
                error = error or {"cleanup_error": str(exc)}
        if changed:
            try:
                restored = restore(client, saved)
            except BaseException as exc:
                error = error or {"restore_error": str(exc)}
        write_new(output / "native-capture-report.json", {
            "case_id": checked["case_id"], "candidate_id": checked["candidate_id"],
            "config_sha256": sha(bundle / "config.json"), "requested_frames": FRAMES,
            "observed_frames": frames, "restoration": restored, "error": error,
            "stop_landmark_readback": landmark_readback,
            "officer_role_verified": False, "officer_direction_observed": None,
            "official_device_verified": False, "legal_verdict": None,
            "accepted": False, "delivery_ready": False})
    if error:
        raise RuntimeError("C10365 Native attempt failed; see capture report")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--bundle", type=Path, default=Path.cwd())
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="localhost")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.check:
        print(json.dumps(check(args.bundle)))
    else:
        if args.output_dir is None:
            raise ValueError("Original Native output directory required")
        capture(args.bundle, args.output_dir, args.host, args.port)

"""Saved-frame joins and measurements; never promote a requested cue to an observation."""
import json
import hashlib
import math
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

from check import check

FRAMES = 480
RATE = 20


def read_rows(path):
    return [json.loads(x) for x in Path(path).read_text().splitlines()]


def finite_number(value):
    return type(value) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(value)


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def verify_media(path):
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Original FFV1 camera missing: " + path.name)
    probe = subprocess.run(
        ["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-count_frames", "-select_streams", "v:0",
         "-show_entries", "stream=codec_name,nb_read_frames",
         "-of", "json", str(path)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    if probe.returncode:
        raise ValueError("Original FFV1 camera unreadable: " + path.name)
    streams = json.loads(probe.stdout).get("streams", [])
    if len(streams) != 1 or streams[0].get("codec_name") != "ffv1" or \
            streams[0].get("nb_read_frames") != str(FRAMES):
        raise ValueError("Original FFV1 camera frame contract: " + path.name)
    return sha(path)


def process(bundle, raw, video, review, *, synthetic=False):
    bundle = Path(bundle)
    checked = check(bundle)
    cfg = json.loads((bundle / "config.json").read_text())
    raw_rows, video_rows = read_rows(raw), read_rows(video)
    requests = read_rows(bundle / "requested-tracks.jsonl")
    visual = json.loads(Path(review).read_text())
    if len(raw_rows) != FRAMES or len(video_rows) != FRAMES or len(requests) != FRAMES:
        raise ValueError("480 source frames required")
    if visual.get("source_kind") != ("synthetic_fixture" if synthetic else "original_native_review"):
        raise ValueError("Review source kind mismatch")
    if visual.get("case_id") != cfg["case_id"] or visual.get("candidate_id") != cfg["candidate_id"]:
        raise ValueError("Review identity mismatch")
    mapping = None
    if not synthetic:
        source_dir = Path(raw).parent
        if Path(video).parent != source_dir:
            raise ValueError("Original video join source directory differs")
        media_hashes = {}
        for name in ("overview.mkv", "rider_forward.mkv", "officer_side.mkv"):
            media_hashes[name] = verify_media(source_dir / name)
        map_path = source_dir / "native-map-readback.json"
        report_path = source_dir / "native-capture-report.json"
        if not map_path.is_file():
            raise ValueError("Original Native map readback missing")
        if not report_path.is_file():
            raise ValueError("Original Native capture report missing")
        mapping = json.loads(map_path.read_text())
        report = json.loads(report_path.read_text())
        landmark = mapping.get("stop_landmark_readback", {})
        if (mapping.get("source_kind") != "original_native" or
                mapping.get("road_sha256") != sha(bundle / "alley-stop.xodr") or
                landmark.get("id") != "3651" or landmark.get("road_id") != 365 or
                landmark.get("type") != "206" or
                not finite_number(landmark.get("s_m")) or
                abs(landmark["s_m"] - 50) > .5 or
                mapping.get("lane_readback") != {
                    str(x): {"road_id": 365, "lane_id": -1, "lane_type": "driving"}
                    for x in (20, 45, 55)}):
            raise ValueError("Original device readback mismatch")
        if (report.get("case_id") != cfg["case_id"] or
                report.get("candidate_id") != cfg["candidate_id"] or
                report.get("config_sha256") != sha(bundle / "config.json") or
                report.get("requested_frames") != FRAMES or
                report.get("observed_frames") != FRAMES or
                report.get("error") is not None or
                report.get("accepted") is not False or
                report.get("delivery_ready") is not False):
            raise ValueError("Original capture receipt mismatch")
        if (visual.get("media_sha256") != media_hashes or
                visual.get("raw_sha256") != sha(raw) or
                visual.get("video_frames_sha256") != sha(video) or
                visual.get("map_sha256") != sha(map_path) or
                visual.get("capture_report_sha256") != sha(report_path)):
            raise ValueError("Original visual review source hashes mismatch")
    speeds, front_x, rider_ids, officer_ids = [], [], set(), set()
    first_native = raw_rows[0].get("native_frame")
    previous_center = None
    for i, (row, v, request) in enumerate(zip(raw_rows, video_rows, requests)):
        if row.get("frame") != i or v.get("video_frame") != i:
            raise ValueError("Frame sequence changed")
        if (type(first_native) is not int or row.get("native_frame") != first_native + i or
                row.get("native_frame") != v.get("native_frame") or
                not finite_number(row.get("time_s")) or
                abs(row["time_s"] - (i + 1) / RATE) > .005 or
                not finite_number(v.get("time_s")) or
                abs(row["time_s"] - v["time_s"]) > 1e-6):
            raise ValueError("Native/video time join changed")
        if row.get("source_kind") != ("synthetic_fixture" if synthetic else "original_native"):
            raise ValueError("Raw source kind mismatch")
        rider, officer = row.get("rider", {}), row.get("officer_actor", {})
        if rider.get("blueprint") != cfg["rider_blueprint"] or \
                not str(officer.get("blueprint", "")).startswith("walker.pedestrian."):
            raise ValueError("Rider/officer actor class mismatch")
        if row.get("observed_road_id") != 365 or row.get("observed_lane_id") != -1:
            raise ValueError("Rider approach lane mismatch")
        if row.get("officer_cue_requested") != cfg["officer_cue_requested"]:
            raise ValueError("Officer request identity changed")
        if (row.get("requested_rider_x_m") != request["requested_rider_x_m"] or
                row.get("requested_speed_mps") != request["requested_speed_mps"]):
            raise ValueError("Original row/request identity changed")
        rider_ids.add(rider.get("actor_id"))
        officer_ids.add(officer.get("actor_id"))
        speed = rider.get("speed_mps")
        center = rider.get("center_native_xyz_m")
        velocity = rider.get("velocity_native_xyz_mps")
        vertices = rider.get("body_native_xyz_m")
        if (not finite_number(speed) or speed < 0 or
                not isinstance(center, list) or len(center) != 3 or
                not all(map(finite_number, center)) or
                not isinstance(velocity, list) or len(velocity) != 3 or
                not all(map(finite_number, velocity)) or
                abs(math.sqrt(sum(vv * vv for vv in velocity)) - speed) > .01 or
                not isinstance(vertices, list) or len(vertices) != 8 or
                not all(isinstance(p, list) and len(p) == 3 and all(map(finite_number, p))
                        for p in vertices)):
            raise ValueError("Original body or speed invalid")
        if previous_center is not None and math.dist(center, previous_center) > speed / RATE + .5:
            raise ValueError("Rider speed/displacement continuity")
        previous_center = center
        officer_center = officer.get("center_native_xyz_m")
        officer_velocity = officer.get("velocity_native_xyz_mps")
        officer_body = officer.get("body_native_xyz_m")
        if (not isinstance(officer_center, list) or len(officer_center) != 3 or
                not all(map(finite_number, officer_center)) or
                not isinstance(officer_velocity, list) or len(officer_velocity) != 3 or
                not all(map(finite_number, officer_velocity)) or
                not finite_number(officer.get("speed_mps")) or
                abs(math.sqrt(sum(vv * vv for vv in officer_velocity)) -
                    officer["speed_mps"]) > .01 or
                not isinstance(officer_body, list) or len(officer_body) != 8 or
                not all(isinstance(p, list) and len(p) == 3 and all(map(finite_number, p))
                        for p in officer_body)):
            raise ValueError("Officer body or speed invalid")
        speeds.append(speed)
        front_x.append(max(p[0] for p in vertices))
    if len(rider_ids) != 1 or len(officer_ids) != 1 or None in rider_ids | officer_ids:
        raise ValueError("Actor identity discontinuity")
    if rider_ids == officer_ids:
        raise ValueError("Rider/officer actor identity collapsed")
    if mapping is not None and (mapping.get("rider_actor_id") not in rider_ids or
                                mapping.get("officer_actor_id") not in officer_ids):
        raise ValueError("Original actor/map identity mismatch")
    stop_runs, current = [], 0
    for speed, front in zip(speeds, front_x):
        current = current + 1 if speed <= .25 and front < 50 else 0
        stop_runs.append(current)
    stopped = max(stop_runs) >= RATE
    crossing_frame = next((i for i, front in enumerate(front_x) if front > 50), None)
    if crossing_frame is not None and crossing_frame == 0:
        raise ValueError("No pre-crossing approach")
    reviewed = visual.get("reviewed_frames")
    if not isinstance(reviewed, list) or not reviewed or \
            any(type(i) is not int or i < 0 or i >= FRAMES for i in reviewed):
        raise ValueError("Visual review frame references invalid")
    if visual.get("device_id") != "3651" or visual.get("device_applicable") is not True:
        raise ValueError("Device applicability unreviewed")
    if visual.get("rider_class") != "bicycle":
        raise ValueError("Rider class unreviewed")
    if visual.get("officer_actor_id") != next(iter(officer_ids)):
        raise ValueError("Officer review actor join")
    direction = visual.get("officer_direction")
    if cfg["case_id"].endswith("probe_a"):
        if direction != "none_contrary" or not stopped or crossing_frame is not None:
            raise ValueError("Ordinary device response not demonstrated")
    else:
        direction_start = visual.get("direction_start_frame")
        direction_end = visual.get("direction_end_frame")
        if (direction != "proceed" or visual.get("officer_authority_reviewed") is not True or
                visual.get("direction_visible") is not True or crossing_frame is None or
                type(direction_start) is not int or type(direction_end) is not int or
                direction_start not in reviewed or direction_end not in reviewed or
                not 0 <= direction_start < direction_end < crossing_frame):
            raise ValueError("Contrary officer direction and response not demonstrated")
    if not synthetic and visual.get("reviewer") in (None, "", "synthetic"):
        raise ValueError("Independent original visual reviewer missing")
    margin = min(50 - f for f, s in zip(front_x, speeds) if s <= .25) \
        if stopped else None
    first_approach = next((i for i, f in enumerate(front_x) if f >= 40), None)
    latency = ((crossing_frame - first_approach) / RATE
               if crossing_frame is not None and first_approach is not None else None)
    separation = min(math.hypot(row["rider"]["center_native_xyz_m"][0] -
                                row["officer_actor"]["center_native_xyz_m"][0],
                                row["rider"]["center_native_xyz_m"][1] -
                                row["officer_actor"]["center_native_xyz_m"][1])
                     for row in raw_rows)
    visibility = visual.get("officer_cue_visibility")
    if not finite_number(visibility) or not 0 <= visibility <= 1:
        raise ValueError("Visibility measurement invalid")
    triggers = {
        "fallback1": margin is not None and margin < 3 or
                     latency is not None and latency < 2,
        "fallback2": visibility < .90,
        "fallback3": separation < 5,
    }
    return {
        "case_id": checked["case_id"], "candidate_id": checked["candidate_id"],
        "source_kind": "synthetic_fixture" if synthetic else "original_native",
        "frames": FRAMES, "stopped": stopped, "crossing_frame": crossing_frame,
        "stop_margin_m": margin, "crossing_latency_s": latency,
        "min_officer_rider_separation_m": separation,
        "officer_cue_visibility": visibility, "fallback_triggers": triggers,
        "officer_direction_reviewed": direction,
        "physical_legal_verdict": None, "delivery_ready": False,
    }

"""Synthetic saved-pipeline positives and material negatives; no original evidence."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile

from build import HERE, CASES, POLICIES, build
from saved import process


def write_rows(path, rows):
    path.write_text("".join(json.dumps(r, sort_keys=True) + "\n" for r in rows))


def fixture(bundle, target):
    cfg = json.loads((bundle / "config.json").read_text())
    requests = [json.loads(x) for x in (bundle / "requested-tracks.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    raw, video = [], []
    officer_x, officer_y = cfg["officer_position_xy_m"]
    for i, request in enumerate(requests):
        x = request["requested_rider_x_m"]
        speed = request["requested_speed_mps"]
        raw.append({
            "frame": i, "native_frame": i + 1000, "time_s": (i + 1) / 20,
            "source_kind": "synthetic_fixture", "officer_cue_requested": cfg["officer_cue_requested"],
            "requested_rider_x_m": request["requested_rider_x_m"],
            "requested_speed_mps": request["requested_speed_mps"],
            "observed_road_id": 365, "observed_lane_id": -1,
            "rider": {"actor_id": 17, "blueprint": cfg["rider_blueprint"],
                      "center_native_xyz_m": [x, -1.75, 1.0],
                      "velocity_native_xyz_mps": [speed, 0, 0],
                      "speed_mps": speed,
                      "body_native_xyz_m": [[x + dx, -1.75 + dy, 1.0]
                                             for dx in (-1, 1) for dy in (-.5, .5)
                                             for _ in (0, 1)]},
            "officer_actor": {
                "actor_id": 23, "blueprint": "walker.pedestrian.0001",
                "center_native_xyz_m": [officer_x, officer_y, 1.0],
                "velocity_native_xyz_mps": [0, 0, 0], "speed_mps": 0,
                "body_native_xyz_m": [[officer_x + dx, officer_y + dy, 1.0]
                                      for dx in (-.3, .3) for dy in (-.3, .3)
                                      for _ in (0, 1)]},
        })
        video.append({"video_frame": i, "native_frame": i + 1000, "time_s": (i + 1) / 20})
    review = {
        "source_kind": "synthetic_fixture", "case_id": cfg["case_id"],
        "candidate_id": cfg["candidate_id"], "reviewed_frames": [100, 150],
        "device_id": "3651", "device_applicable": True, "rider_class": "bicycle",
        "officer_actor_id": 23,
        "officer_direction": "none_contrary" if cfg["case_id"].endswith("probe_a") else "proceed",
        "direction_start_frame": None if cfg["case_id"].endswith("probe_a") else 100,
        "direction_end_frame": None if cfg["case_id"].endswith("probe_a") else 150,
        "officer_authority_reviewed": cfg["case_id"].endswith("probe_b"),
        "direction_visible": cfg["case_id"].endswith("probe_b"),
        "officer_cue_visibility": .97,
        "reviewer": "synthetic",
    }
    paths = [target / "raw.jsonl", target / "video.jsonl", target / "review.json"]
    write_rows(paths[0], raw)
    write_rows(paths[1], video)
    paths[2].write_text(json.dumps(review))
    return paths


def prove():
    build()
    positives, negatives = [], []
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        target = Path(tmp)
        for suffix in CASES:
            for candidate in POLICIES:
                bundle = HERE / "drafts" / suffix / candidate
                raw, video, review = fixture(bundle, target)
                positives.append(process(bundle, raw, video, review, synthetic=True))
                base_raw = raw.read_text()
                base_video = video.read_text()
                base_review = review.read_text()
                mutations = (
                    ("frame_join", video, base_video.replace('"native_frame": 1000', '"native_frame": 999', 1)),
                    ("actor_class", raw, base_raw.replace("vehicle.bh.crossbike", "vehicle.tesla.model3", 1)),
                    ("officer_cue", raw, base_raw.replace(CASES[suffix], "unrelated", 1)),
                    ("device_applicability", review, base_review.replace('"device_applicable": true', '"device_applicable": false')),
                    ("officer_identity", review, base_review.replace('"officer_actor_id": 23', '"officer_actor_id": 99')),
                    ("direction", review, base_review.replace(
                        '"officer_direction": "none_contrary"' if suffix == "probe_a" else
                        '"officer_direction": "proceed"', '"officer_direction": "unreviewed"')),
                )
                for name, path, bad in mutations:
                    path.write_text(bad)
                    try:
                        process(bundle, raw, video, review, synthetic=True)
                    except (ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
                        negatives.append({"case": suffix, "candidate": candidate,
                                          "mutation": name, "rejected": str(exc)})
                    else:
                        raise AssertionError(f"{suffix}/{candidate}/{name} accepted")
                    path.write_text({raw: base_raw, video: base_video, review: base_review}[path])
                raw.write_text(base_raw.replace('"source_kind": "synthetic_fixture"',
                                                '"source_kind": "original_native"'))
                review.write_text(base_review.replace('"source_kind": "synthetic_fixture"',
                                                      '"source_kind": "original_native_review"'))
                try:
                    process(bundle, raw, video, review, synthetic=False)
                except ValueError as exc:
                    if "Original FFV1 camera missing" not in str(exc):
                        raise
                    negatives.append({"case": suffix, "candidate": candidate,
                                      "mutation": "missing_original_media", "rejected": str(exc)})
                else:
                    raise AssertionError(f"{suffix}/{candidate}/missing_original_media accepted")
                review.write_text(base_review)
                structured = (
                    ("rider_velocity", lambda rows: rows[0]["rider"].update(
                        velocity_native_xyz_mps=[0, 0, 0])),
                    ("officer_body", lambda rows: rows[0]["officer_actor"].update(
                        body_native_xyz_m=[])),
                    ("rider_displacement", lambda rows: rows[1]["rider"][
                        "center_native_xyz_m"].__setitem__(0, 99.0)),
                    ("source_time", lambda rows: rows[0].update(time_s=.4)),
                    ("requested_source", lambda rows: rows[0].update(requested_speed_mps=99)),
                )
                for name, mutate in structured:
                    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in base_raw.splitlines()]
                    mutate(rows)
                    write_rows(raw, rows)
                    try:
                        process(bundle, raw, video, review, synthetic=True)
                    except (ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
                        negatives.append({"case": suffix, "candidate": candidate,
                                          "mutation": name, "rejected": str(exc)})
                    else:
                        raise AssertionError(f"{suffix}/{candidate}/{name} accepted")
    result = {"format": "c10365-synthetic-saved-proof-v1",
              "positive_count": len(positives), "negative_count": len(negatives),
              "positives": positives, "negatives": negatives,
              "physical_original_observed": False, "delivery_ready": False}
    (HERE / "saved-proof.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    result = prove()
    print(json.dumps({"positive_count": result["positive_count"],
                      "negative_count": result["negative_count"]}))

import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from check import check
from prove_saved import fixture
from saved import process

class ExactOfficer(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_source_and_unverified_status(self):
        row = check(Path.cwd())
        self.assertFalse(row["delivery_ready"])
        self.assertIsNone(row["officer_direction_observed"])
        self.assertIsNone(row["legal_verdict"])

    def test_requested_pair_behavior(self):
        row = check(Path.cwd())
        if row["case_id"].endswith("probe_a"):
            self.assertGreater(row["requested_stop_frames"], 0)
            self.assertFalse(row["requested_crossing"])
        else:
            self.assertEqual(row["requested_stop_frames"], 0)
            self.assertTrue(row["requested_crossing"])

    def test_synthetic_saved_join(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            raw, video, review = fixture(Path.cwd(), Path(folder))
            row = process(Path.cwd(), raw, video, review, synthetic=True)
            self.assertEqual(row["frames"], 480)
            self.assertFalse(row["delivery_ready"])
            self.assertIsNone(row["physical_legal_verdict"])
